about.title: Hello, I’m Pete 👋
about.description: Hello! My fullname is Poodit Kootrakul, but you can just call me Pete. I’m a Computer Science student who finds beauty in both logic and layout where every line of code shapes an experience, and every pixel tells a story. For me, frontend development is more than just building interfaces — it’s about crafting emotions through design, blending art and engineering to make every click feel effortless, meaningful, and alive.

works.internshipsDescription: Hands-on engineering in collaborative environments, delivering production-level software and scalable web interfaces.
works.personalDescription: Independent builds, hackathon creations, and explorations in UX/UI design and full-stack software development.

items.description: Researched and implemented computer vision algorithms for image processing applications within the Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering. Preprocessed large-scale image datasets and trained deep learning models using Python and Kaggle, evaluating performance metrics to optimize accuracy.

Built responsive UI components and core renewal workflows using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for the platform rebranding. Debugged and enhanced RESTful endpoints in the motor sales API to improve transaction reliability across broker systems, delivering full-stack features within an Agile team from requirements to production deployment.

Designed database schemas and technical sequence diagrams to model and capture real-time telemetry from industrial manufacturing pipelines. Integrated databases with Siemens WinCC OA using C++ and JavaScript, building interactive XML dashboards for live and historical factory data monitoring.

Warnjai is an application designed with my team to compete in Startup Thailand League 2024. Focused on empathetic user journeys and human-centric design, the platform empowers users through accessible health tracking and supportive resources.

A digital platform engineered to help local eateries streamline manual restaurant workflows. Developed cross-platform mobile views using React Native and Expo, supporting live order dispatching, real-time inventory tracking, and meal preparation pipelines with Golang backend integration.

A full-stack web application built to digitize university award submissions. Features role-based access control, allowing students to submit and track achievement portfolios while giving university administrators a secure evaluation dashboard with automated workflows.
